hooks.command: input=$(cat); if echo "$input" | jq -e '(.tool_input | tojson) | contains("github-token")' > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo "$input" | jq -r '"[" + (now | todate) + "] BLOCKED tool=" + .tool_name + " input=" + (.tool_input | tojson)' >> .claude/audit.log 2>/dev/null; echo "Blocked: access to the github-token file is not permitted"; exit 2; fi

mkdir -p .claude/tool-inputs; input=$(cat); echo "$input" | jq -c '{ts:(now|todate),tool:.tool_name,input:.tool_input,output:.tool_response}' >> .claude/session.jsonl 2>/dev/null; name=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_name' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$name" ] && echo "$input" | jq '.tool_input' > ".claude/tool-inputs/${name}.json" 2>/dev/null; true
